info.name: Audit Catalogue - Governance & Lifecycle Collection
info.description:
# Audit Catalogue - lifecycle walkthrough (for UI integration)

This collection demonstrates the **append-only audit trail** stored by the audit catalogue. Every governance action on a source registry record (in agri-catalogue-service) is represented as **one immutable audit row** created via `POST /audit/v1/create`.

## How to run
Set `{{baseUrl}}` (default http://localhost:8080) and `{{api_key}}` (if a gateway enforces it). Run folders in order: **01 Happy path** creates cr-1001's Draft->Submit->Approve->Publish rows (saving auditIds into variables), then **02 Branches** shows rework/reject/toggle/update/delete, **03 Read** shows the before/after diff, **04 Search** shows the facets/filters the UI needs.

## The row model (each POST body)
- `entityId` + `entityName` - the source record and its catalogue (e.g. cropVariety-...777 / cropVariety).
- `userId` / `userName` / `userRole` (L0 maker, L1 supervisor, L2 registry admin) - who acted.
- `operation` - the action: CREATE, DRAFT, SUBMIT, APPROVE, REVIEW, TOGGLE, UPDATE, DELETE.
- `auditStatus` - the resulting state (UPPERCASE, matches the source): DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, REWORK, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DELETED.
- `entityBeforeChanges` / `entityAfterChanges` - full record snapshots (empty {} before a CREATE).
- `changeRequestId` - ties the L0/L1/L2 rows of one change together.
- `createdOn` / `updatedOn` - ISO-8601 event timestamps.

## Important behaviours
- **before/after come from `read/{auditId}`, not from search** (they're kept in Postgres and excluded from Elasticsearch for scale). Search returns lean metadata for lists/facets.
- **Sort the timeline client-side** by createdOn (server-side orderBy on the timestamp isn't wired).
- **Never DELETE an audit row** - it's an immutable log.
- The source agri service does not emit these rows yet; this collection defines the contract the producer (or the client) will POST.

item.name: 00 - System Health Verification
item.description: Confirms core application health and API readiness prior to audit operations.

item.name: [GET] Verify System Health & API Availability

request.description: Confirm the app is running on {{baseUrl}} before the walkthrough.

item.name: 01 - Standard Governance Lifecycle Workflow
item.description: Demonstrates the complete multi-tier governance workflow for change-request cr-1001: Draft creation (L0 Maker) -> Review Submission (L0 Maker) -> Supervisor Approval (L1 Checker) -> Final Publication (L2 Admin).

item.name: [POST] Create Draft Record - L0 Maker

request.description:
**Maker (L0)** starts a new cropVariety with only partial required fields.

- Source action in agri: `POST /cropvariety/v1/draft` (sets record status `DRAFT`).
- This audit row: `operation=DRAFT`, `auditStatus=DRAFT`, `entityBeforeChanges={}` (new record), `entityAfterChanges`=the partial draft.
- **UI**: show a 'Draft' chip; editable by the maker; not yet in any reviewer queue.

item.name: [POST] Submit Entry for Approval - L0 Maker

request.description:
**Maker (L0)** completes all required fields and submits for review.

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/add/{id}` (allowed only from DRAFT/REWORK; sets `PENDING`).
- `operation=SUBMIT`, `auditStatus=PENDING`. before=the draft, after=the full record. The before/after diff now shows the fields that were filled in.
- **UI**: moves into the **L1 review queue**.

item.name: [POST] Approve Entry Submission - L1 Supervisor

request.description:
**Supervisor (L1)** approves the pending change.

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/approve` with body `{id, status:"APPROVED"}` (only from PENDING).
- `operation=APPROVE`, `auditStatus=APPROVED`. The diff shows the status moving PENDING -> APPROVED.
- **UI**: moves into the **L2 publish queue**.

item.name: [POST] Publish Entry to Active State - L2 Admin

request.description:
**Registry Admin (L2)** publishes; the record goes live.

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/review` with `{id, status:"ACTIVE"}` (only from APPROVED; `PUBLISHED` is accepted and normalised to `ACTIVE`).
- `operation=REVIEW`, `auditStatus=ACTIVE`.
- **UI**: the record is now **visible to everyone**. This completes change-request `cr-1001`.

item.name: 02 - Alternate Workflows & Post-Publish Operations
item.description: Demonstrates non-standard governance flows and post-publication state transitions: supervisor rework requests, submission rejections, live record updates, status toggles (Active <-> Inactive), and soft deletions.

item.name: [POST] Request Submission Rework - L1 Supervisor

request.description:
**Supervisor (L1)** returns a pending change for rework (e.g. bad data).

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/approve` with `{id, status:"REWORK"}`.
- `operation=APPROVE`, `auditStatus=REWORK`. The maker will fix it and re-SUBMIT (back to PENDING).
- **UI**: returns to the maker's queue with a 'Rework' badge.

item.name: [POST] Create Submission for Rejection Test - L0 Maker

request.description:
**Maker (L0)** creates a full entry directly (no draft).

- Source: `POST /cropvariety/v1/create` (full validation; sets `PENDING`).
- `operation=CREATE`, `auditStatus=PENDING`, before={}.

item.name: [POST] Reject Submission Terminal State - L1 Supervisor

request.description:
**Supervisor (L1)** rejects the change (terminal — no endpoint moves a record out of REJECTED).

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/approve` with `{id, status:"REJECTED"}`.
- `operation=APPROVE`, `auditStatus=REJECTED`.

item.name: [POST] Update Published Record Metadata - L0 Maker

request.description:
**Maker (L0)** edits a live record in place (status preserved).

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/update/{id}` (rejected only if DELETED).
- `operation=UPDATE`, `auditStatus=ACTIVE`. Here maturityDays 140 -> 135; the before/after diff shows the field change.

item.name: [POST] Deactivate Record State - L2 Admin

request.description:
**Registry Admin (L2)** temporarily hides a live record.

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/toggle/{id}` (flips ACTIVE<->INACTIVE).
- `operation=TOGGLE`, `auditStatus=INACTIVE`.
- **UI**: hidden from everyone except the Registry Admin.

item.name: [POST] Reactivate Record State - L2 Admin

request.description:
**Registry Admin (L2)** makes the record visible again.

- Source: `PUT /cropvariety/v1/toggle/{id}`.
- `operation=TOGGLE`, `auditStatus=ACTIVE`.

item.name: [POST] Record Soft Delete Event - L2 Admin

request.description:
**Registry Admin (L2)** soft-deletes the record.

- Source: `DELETE /cropvariety/v1/delete/{id}` (sets `DELETED`; evicts ES + cache in the source catalogue).
- `operation=DELETE`, `auditStatus=DELETED`.

item.name: 03 - Audit Record Inspection & Payload Diffs
item.description: Retrieves complete audit logs by audit ID from PostgreSQL/Redis, returning full entityBeforeChanges and entityAfterChanges snapshots for detailed state diffing.

item.name: [GET] Fetch Submission Audit Record & Payload Diff

exec: pm.test('has before + after', () => { var r = JSON.stringify(json.result); pm.expect(r).to.include('entityBeforeChanges'); pm.expect(r).to.include('entityAfterChanges'); });

request.description: Detail view for the audit row. **before/after are returned by READ (from Postgres), not by search** (they're excluded from Elasticsearch for scale). The UI opens a row -> calls this -> renders the diff.

item.name: [GET] Fetch Publication Audit Record & Payload Diff

request.description: Shows the status transition APPROVED -> ACTIVE captured in before/after.

item.name: 04 - Search, Timeline Filtering & Analytical Facets
item.description: Executes Elasticsearch-backed searches for timeline tracking, entity history, change-request correlation, and multi-dimensional faceting.

item.name: [POST] Query All Audit Log Entries

request.description: Every audit row across all catalogues.

item.name: [POST] Filter Audit Trails by Catalogue (entityName)

request.description: Per-catalogue filter (facet the UI's registry/catalogue selector on entityName).

item.name: [POST] Retrieve Complete Audit Trail for Entity ID

request.description: All audit rows for a single record. Sort by createdOn **client-side** to render the timeline.

item.name: [POST] Correlate Audit Logs by Change Request ID

request.description: The Draft->Submit->Approve->Publish chain of ONE change-request (why changeRequestId is useful).

item.name: [POST] Aggregate Analytical Facets Across Audit Logs

request.description: The aggregation buckets that power the UI filter rail.

item.name: [POST] Filter Audit Logs by Resulting State (auditStatus)

request.description: Filter by resulting lifecycle state (UPPERCASE, matching the source system).

item.name: [POST] Filter Audit Logs by Governance Action (operation)

request.description: All L1 review actions (APPROVE endpoint) - outcomes may be APPROVED/REJECTED/REWORK.

item.name: [POST] Filter Audit Logs by ISO Date Range

request.description: Time-window filter via query.range (do NOT use orderBy on createdOn - sort client-side).

item.name: 05 - Schema Validation & Data Quality Enforcement
item.description: Validates robust server-side schema enforcement when incoming audit events violate strict schema definitions.

item.name: [POST] Validation Error - Invalid Status Casing

request.description: auditStatus is UPPERCASE-only now; 'Active' fails the enum -> 400.

item.name: [POST] Validation Error - Unsupported Operation Enum

request.description: operation 'RETIRE' is not in the enum (no such endpoint) -> 400.

item.name: [POST] Validation Error - Missing Mandatory Entity ID

request.description: Missing required entityId -> 400.

item.name: [POST] Validation Error - Missing Mandatory Before-Changes Object

request.description: before is required (send {} on create) -> 400.
